title: Warm Fatty Norwegian Lamb Casserole
description: A hearty Norwegian lamb casserole featuring garlic and molten flavors, perfect for a cold winter night, this dish is also macrobiotic-friendly and can be meal-prepped in advance.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the lamb shoulder to the pot, browning it on all sides.
Add the sliced carrots and potatoes to the pot, stirring to combine.
Season with salt, black pepper, and fresh thyme.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and broil for an additional 5 minutes to brown the top.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
